scope: Known DEV map48 18 candidate conditions, two task roots, no new physics. All G/I/C selection sees predicted gates/time only; true future solely scoring. Oracle uses actual outcomes as offline upper bound.
geometry: Exact reference at1.8m/s, yaw tangent, level posture, initial locked joints and constant height; original goal hold and obstacle/world envelope gates. No dynamic prediction.
backtracking: Full same-candidate/predictor/gate traversal, no greedy truncation; selection time excludes cached model queries.
calibration: Raw envelopes, no newly calibrated margins; not formal P4 acceptance
